about.text: English blue cheese similar to Blue Stilton cheese, except that it does not use pasteurised milk or factory-produced rennet.

sources.text: raw Friesian-Holstein milk, calf rennet (confirmed); Nottinghamshire; Wikipedia gives no ripening time
